Knopik no longer puts on a brave face: he is quiet, serious and a little sad, saying goodbye to Lichtenau, the office and Lina. He knows he may not return, and he is ready. He almost pities the Count: he has never seen the sun.
Ставни восточного окна справа. За ними р: The east window shutters to the right. Dawn lies beyond them. The Count lies right by the window.
Глава последняя. Ночь. Дом Лины стал огр: The final chapter. Night. Lina's house has grown huge and dark, like an empty picture house.
Лина говорит с графом, тихо-тихо. Держит: Lina talks to the Count, softly, softly. Holding him. And I must reach the window. Not being brave. Just rolling.
Тот, кто дёргает за нитки. Я не прошу по: You who pull the strings. I don't ask for mercy. Just let me reach the shutters.
The shutters. Cold. Beyond them the sky grows light. Count, have you ever seen a sunrise? You're about to.
Лина, прости, что уехал. И спасибо, что: Lina, sorry I left. And thank you for waiting. Buy the geraniums yourself. Two.
Раз... два... Я всегда сначала прыгал, а: One... two... I always jumped first and thought later. Today I thought. Jumping anyway. Three!
Конец фильма. Кнопик стал утренним лучом: The end of the picture. Knopik became a ray of morning. They say Lichtenau now has the warmest sunrises.
Дверь в спальню ведёт в кухню, кухня — в: The bedroom door leads to the kitchen, the kitchen to the hall. The house is asleep and dreaming. Nightmares.
Пол проваливается. Ну и пусть. Я уже пад: The floor gives way. So be it. I've fallen before. I know how to put myself back together.
Перина! Та самая, мягкая. Лина, я прыгаю: The featherbed! That soft one. Lina, I'm jumping on your featherbed. Don't scold me.
Не молюсь об удаче. Молюсь, чтобы Лина д: I don't pray for luck. I pray that Lina holds on. A little more. Just a little more.
Портьера упала. Бархатная лепёшка. Самая: The curtain fell. A velvet pancake. The softest pancake of my life.
Вот он. Длинный, тихий, как тень от свеч: There he is. Long and quiet, like a candle's shadow. He's afraid of the light too. So am I. We're alike.
Небо светлеет. Граф, прости. Лихтенау, д: The sky is brightening. Count, forgive me. Lichtenau, hold on. Shutters, open up.
Письмо Кнопика, неотправленное: «Лина, я: Knopik's unsent letter: “Lina, I'm bringing you the mountains. Little ones, in my pocket.” I have no pocket.
Договор с печатью. Кнопик сам его подпис: The sealed contract. Knopik signed it himself. He tears it up. Now the Count is in Lichtenau illegally.
Страница из книги: «Кто отдаст тьме свой: A page from the book: “Who gives their light to the dark shall kindle the morning.” Good book. Scary, but good.
